core.headline: New-build semi-detached house in Kings Hill, West Malling
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house, The Larch, at Orchard Rise in Kings Hill, West Malling. Completion is expected in spring 2027, and the property is offered with no onward chain. The developer is offering a contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). Underfloor heating is installed throughout the ground floor. The first floor has three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with an en-suite, plus a family bathroom. Radiators heat the first floor.

Outside, there is a turfed rear garden with a patio and two allocated parking spaces. An EV charging point is installed.

Kings Hill is located approx. 2 miles from West Malling station. Mains electricity, water and sewerage are connected; water is metered. Fibre-to-the-premises broadband is available.

Fixed Price £410,000. A reservation fee of £1,500 is required, deducted from the price on completion; it is refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Freehold with an estate charge of £295 per year. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). Predicted EPC rating B. Construction: standard – brick and block under a tiled roof. Heating: air source heat pump; underfloor heating downstairs, radiators upstairs. A 10-year NHBC warranty is included. The final EPC will be issued on completion.
core.summary: New-build three-bedroom semi-detached house in Kings Hill, West Malling, with air source heat pump, underfloor heating, EV charging point and two allocated parking spaces. Completion spring 2027.
